name: Dr Rooma Sinha
verified_role: Senior Consultant Gynecologist, Laparoscopic & Robotic Surgeon, Apollo Hospitals Jubilee Hills (Apollo Cradle), Hyderabad; Clinical Lead - Gynecological Robotic Surgery, Apollo Hospitals Group; Lead Faculty, Fellowship in Minimal Access & Robotic Surgery, Apollo; Honorary (Associate) Professor, Apollo Hospitals Education & Research Foundation (AHERF)
verified_experience: 25+ years (input) - Practo states 35 years overall (29 as specialist); her website states ~30 years of clinical practice (~12 focused on robotic surgery). MBBS 1989, AP Medical Council registration 1998.
hni_signals: Nationally prominent robotic gynecologic surgeon - pioneer of robotic gynecology in India (since 2012) with reportedly the highest number of robotic myomectomies in India. Founder and President of the Association of Gynaecological Robotic Surgeons of India; Joint Secretary of the Endometriosis Society of India. Clinical Lead for Gynecological Robotic Surgery across the Apollo Hospitals Group; Lead Faculty of Apollo's Fellowship in Minimal Access & Robotic Surgery; Honorary Professor at AHERF and Conjoint Associate Professor, Macquarie University, Sydney. Qualifications: MBBS (IMS, Banaras Hindu University, 1989), MD Obstetrics & Gynaecology (BHU, 1993), DNB (1994), MICOG, PGDMLS, MNAMS. Member AAGL, ACOG, FOGSI, IMA, IMS, NESA. Awards include Naari of the Decade (2021), Distinguished Clinician - Apollo (2021), FICCI Excellence in Medicine, Times Legend in Gynecology (2018), Hi9 Best Laparoscopic & Robotic Surgeon (2018). Maintains her own professional website (drroomasinha.in). Very strong seniority/leadership signals.
